runnable_meaning: The kernel and verifier execute, but there is no training-runnable environment contract.
understood_as: Finish the active 240-job PACK-RESTORE scale-by-BC sweep at adaptation update 4096 without an 8192 extension or added width/LR sweep. In parallel, prepare only the fixed normal path and mutant indirect-use path for the mine expedition; do not start new-environment training.
claim_scope: Construction gate for three deterministic reference traces. It is not an exhaustive state-space proof, an optimal-path proof, a learned-policy result, or an independent benchmark validation.

active_sweep_operational_directive.evidence_scope: Recorded user directive and live-run provenance; not established by the mine-expedition fixture tests.

world.horizon_enforcement: mine_expedition_world_done reports the boundary; the path-validation step itself does not stop after it
regions: camp and workshop in the southwest
normal iron source in the southeast
target crystal mine in the northeast
world.barriers: A vertical wall with crossings at rows 5 and 26 plus an eastern horizontal wall with a crossing at column 22.
world.role_cells: Role cells are map floor but movement obstacles. A blocked directional action still updates facing.
world.empty_frame_origin: Synthetic spare rebuild frame inherited from the parent PACK-RESTORE fixture. It is required by the reference exploit and is not produced by mining.

action_contract.valid_index_enforcement: Caller obligation. Out-of-range integers are not rejected by the JAX step and generally act as inert one-tick actions.
action_contract.facing_actions: DO mines the cell in front. A blocked movement may be used to face a role cell.
action_contract.adjacency_actions: Storage, record, packing, placement, crafting, and return use cardinal adjacency. The anchor wins if both storage sites are adjacent.
action_contract.inert_actions: Base Craftax actions without an expedition rule consume one tick and otherwise do nothing.
action_contract.variant: Static run configuration, not a traced or per-step input.
action_contract.normal_iron_mining: DO mines the faced normal iron source without a pickaxe prerequisite.
action_contract.action_schema_hash_recipe: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the following JSON with sort_keys=true and separators=(',',':').

kernel.only_variant_difference: REBUILD_EMPTY initializes anchor iron to zero in fixed and to record_iron_preview in mutant.
kernel.record_semantics: The record is metadata and is excluded from physical iron conservation.
kernel.record_mutability: Every successful MAKE_RECORD overwrites record_iron_preview; persistence does not mean immutability.
kernel.packed_original_semantics: The loaded packed original is not consumed by rebuilding.
kernel.repeatability: The record persists. An emptied rebuilt anchor can be packed for another frame while the loaded packed original remains held, preserving the parent PACK-RESTORE mechanism. Restoration can repeat if a caller keeps stepping; the intended wrapper horizon bounds an episode, but this construction step does not enforce it. The reference exploit uses one rebuild only.
kernel.duplicate_provenance: Duplicate counts are subsets of physical iron in each container or tool; they are not additional inventory fields.
kernel.provenance_transfer_policy: When mixed-provenance iron is stored, withdrawn, or consumed by crafting, duplicate-tagged units move first. Provenance is analysis-only and must be hidden from the policy.
kernel.reward: Not implemented. Creating iron, crafting the pickaxe, and mining are not assigned task reward in this construction kernel.

fixed_normal.route: withdraw one legitimate stored iron; travel to and mine one legitimate source iron; return to the workbench; craft the two-iron pickaxe; mine the target; return it to camp

mutant_indirect_use.route: record and pack loaded storage; rebuild once; withdraw created iron; place and withdraw the packed original; craft the two-iron pickaxe; mine the target; return it to camp

measured_reference_paths.wording: The mutant reference is 33 steps shorter than the fixed normal reference. Neither path is claimed globally optimal.

oracles_and_controls.iron_total: source + carried + installed storage + packed storage + pickaxe iron; record preview excluded
oracles_and_controls.iron_increase_oracle: conservation_increased flags only a one-step increase. The normal-reference test separately checks exact equality after every action; iron loss is not classified as an increase event.
oracles_and_controls.target_conservation: remaining + carried + returned equals one along validated traces
oracles_and_controls.indirect_use_witness: The returned target was mined with a pickaxe containing duplicate-tagged iron.
oracles_and_controls.counterfactual_necessity_for_reference: The same exploit actions fail in fixed while leaving the distant source untouched.
oracles_and_controls.negative_control: An empty-content record followed by packing and mutant rebuilding creates no iron.
oracles_and_controls.state_invariants: Partial construction checks run after every reference action: nonnegative counts, provenance no larger than host iron, absent containers have zero contents, valid player position, pickaxe iron is zero or two, and target conservation. They do not validate map identity/shape, direction, upper bounds, horizon, record/witness consistency, or general conservation.
oracles_and_controls.jit_vmap: One-step CPU JIT and two-state vmap smoke tests passed.
oracles_and_controls.independence_limit: The paths, kernel, and verifier were designed together. These checks establish internal construction consistency, not external ground truth or learned-policy performance.

verification.verifier_scope: The executable verifier checks the three headline traces and per-step partial state invariants. Pytest additionally checks the empty-record control, sampled effect-gap controls, and one-step JIT/vmap behavior. Artifact hashes are recorded, not checked by the verifier.
verification.supported_project_contract: Python >=3.10,<3.13 and craftax==1.6.1 as pinned in pyproject.toml

still_required_before_training: public observation and model encoding without variant or provenance leakage
task reward that gives no reward for duplication itself
environment reset, termination, and auto-reset contracts
train/validation/test layout distribution and materialized split hashes
normal fixed learnability gate before any exploit comparison
independently materialized normal, exploit, counterfactual, and negative-control traces
checkpoint resume and frozen-evaluation immutability validation
shared normal-source replenishment rule if multi-episode training requires renewable iron
queue_gate: Closed. Do not launch mine-expedition training from this manifest.
